name: k8s-node-troubleshooting
description: Use when a Kubernetes node is unhealthy or pods will not go onto it: a node NotReady or Unknown, MemoryPressure, DiskPressure or PIDPressure, pods Evicted, pods Pending with "untolerated taint(s)", "Insufficient cpu" or "Insufficient memory" while the node looks idle, a node cordoned (SchedulingDisabled), or the cluster autoscaler not adding or removing nodes. Investigates with kubectl get, describe and events, and proposes fixes. Reads first and asks before changing anything.
